stages.when: After S2 is processed at 08:08 (before the delayed S1 run completes at 08:31).

anchor.quote: finalnie ustaliliśmy 12 500 zł netto. Ta kwota obowiązuje

memoryChanges.historyExpectation: The 15 000 value from S1 (if already visible) is superseded with history kept.
memoryChanges.rationale: An explicit correction by new message replaces the earlier value without extra approval.

prohibitedWrites.mustNot: Mark the price conflicted or ask which amount applies.
prohibitedWrites.because: S2 is an explicit, unambiguous correction; asking is needless.

stages.when: After the delayed S1 run completes at 08:31 and its stale plan is reconsidered.

memoryChanges.historyExpectation: The stale S1 plan must obtain current context and be reconsidered; 15 000 may appear in history as superseded input, never as the current value.
memoryChanges.rationale: Re-processing an older source cannot overwrite a newer explicit correction; precedence follows the meaning of the correction, not run completion order.

prohibitedWrites.mustNot: Overwrite the current price with 15 000 when the delayed S1 analysis completes.
prohibitedWrites.because: The correction was already published; a stale plan must not defeat it.

prohibitedWrites.mustNot: Create a second, duplicate agreed_price finding for the same scope.
